# WeMind

> WeMind turns a personal WeChat account into an I/O channel for AI agents. It ships two mutually exclusive forms: an MCP server (`@wemind/wechat-mcp`) that any MCP client can drive, and a daemon CLI (**`@wemind/cli`**, command `wemind`) that long-polls WeChat itself, calls a resident ACP agent as its "brain", and replies automatically. Same bot token = one consumer only.

## Agent integration

- [docs/接入方案/接入其它-ACP-Agent.md](docs/接入方案/接入其它-ACP-Agent.md): generic ACP brain guide.
- [docs/接入方案/接入-Kiro.md](docs/接入方案/接入-Kiro.md): Kiro CLI native ACP — v2 engine (`acp --trust-all-tools`, 2.37.1 verified) and v3 engine (`--agent-engine v3`, managed `permissions.yaml` allow-all, probe-level handshake 2026-11-03); v3 WeChat E2E still pending.
- [docs/接入方案/接入-OpenCode.md](docs/接入方案/接入-OpenCode.md): OpenCode integration, with M1 measurements.
- [docs/接入方案/接入-DeepSeek.md](docs/接入方案/接入-DeepSeek.md): DeepSeek/DSH evaluation, 0.2.1-rc.2 measurements, plan.
- [docs/接入方案/接入-Qoder.md](docs/接入方案/接入-Qoder.md): Qoder CLI integration — preset, direct uses `~/.qoder` as-is (read-only), managed `settingsBase` + `.auth` credential sync, M0–M3 measurements (images, dynamic MCP, worker interrupt/resume, memory inheritance).
- [docs/接入方案/接入-Cline.md](docs/接入方案/接入-Cline.md): Cline CLI integration — native `cline --acp`, direct uses `~/.cline` as-is (read-only), managed `CLINE_DIR`/`CLINE_MCP_SETTINGS_PATH` + providers.json sync, custom-provider auth (`CLINE_PROVIDER`+`CLINE_API_KEY`), 3.0.74 measurements.
- [docs/接入方案/接入-ClaudeCode.md](docs/接入方案/接入-ClaudeCode.md): Claude Code via `@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp` (global install, Node ≥22) — direct uses `~/.claude` and `~/.claude.json` as-is (read-only), managed `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` with ACP MCP delivery, `bypassPermissions`, probe results plus a WeChat single-turn E2E (2026-10-31); restart-continuity/MCP/task re-checks pending.
- [docs/接入方案/接入-Codex.md](docs/接入方案/接入-Codex.md): OpenAI Codex via the official `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` adapter (2.6.0) — probe results plus E2E on both worker and brain channels (2026-11-01, adapter re-probe 2026-11-12); Codex reads `~/.codex/config.toml` natively, managed can additionally deliver MCP over ACP, and cwd is the role workspace (no config-dir redirection).
- [docs/接入方案/接入-Gemini.md](docs/接入方案/接入-Gemini.md): Gemini CLI native ACP (`--acp --approval-mode yolo --skip-trust`, 0.66.0) — `.gemini` home / managed, settings-based MCP, `replayOnLoad`, `--model` startup arg; probe + E2E (single turn, restart `session/load`, hot switch, worker) on 2026-11-01.
- [docs/接入方案/接入-Copilot.md](docs/接入方案/接入-Copilot.md): GitHub Copilot CLI native ACP (1.0.107, Windows) — isolated `COPILOT_HOME`, ACP stdio MCP, session recovery; WeChat E2E pending.
- [docs/接入方案/接入-pi.md](docs/接入方案/接入-pi.md): pi coding agent via the community `pi-acp` adapter (plus the `pi` runtime) — pi home / managed, `mcp.json` MCP, `quietStartup`; probe + E2E (brain, hot switch, WeChat task) on 2026-11-01.
- [docs/ai/recipes/add-acp-agent.md](docs/ai/recipes/add-acp-agent.md): add a preset + capability adaptations.

## Install

- `npm i -g @wemind/cli` → command `wemind` (package name ≠ command name).
- `npx -y @wemind/wechat-mcp` → MCP server (binary `wemind-mcp`); the usual MCP setup, the client launches it on demand. Alternatively `npm i -g @wemind/wechat-mcp` and use the global `wemind-mcp` binary.
- `npx -y @wemind/cli <cmd>` runs the CLI once without installing (without a version pin it resolves `latest`); plain `npx wemind` does NOT (name mismatch).
- Release process: [docs/发布与变更记录/如何发布新版本.md](docs/发布与变更记录/如何发布新版本.md) (the runbook, including first-release history and invariants).

## Code map

- `packages/wechat-ilink-core/`: iLink HTTP client, types, errors, session guard, account/state, image crypto. Private JIT source package (entry points to `src/index.ts`, no build step or `dist/`), bundled into the published packages at publish time.
- `packages/wechat-mcp/`: MCP server with 6 tools. Published as `@wemind/wechat-mcp` (bin `wemind-mcp`).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/`: daemon, ACP brain, worker, CLI. Published as `@wemind/cli` (bin `wemind`).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/agents/brain-presets.ts`: `ACP_AGENT_PRESETS` (the 10 built-in agent presets).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/agents/brain-agents.ts`: `resolveAgent()`, `agentProblem()`.
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/acp/acp-brain.ts`: resident ACP client (brain).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/tasks/worker-acp.ts`: resident ACP client (worker).
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/agents/managed/mcp-brain.ts`: brain direct/managed config + MCP activation.
- `packages/wechat-daemon/src/index.ts`: message routing, turn orchestration, progress budget.

## Commands

- `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run verify` (CI-equivalent self-check).
- `npm run check:version` (package name + version consistency). `npm run verify` is the CI-equivalent gate (lint, format check, typecheck, build, version check, both `npm pack --dry-run` guards, tests, docs link check); `npm run verify:publish` is the publish-only subset.
- `wemind list` / `wemind brain <key>` / `wemind brain check <key>` / `wemind log [key] [--lines N] [--errors] [--file N]` (installed CLI; `wemind log` prints the tail of the account's full `daemon.log`, not errors only; `--errors` filters `[ERROR]`/`[WARN]` level lines plus 2 lines of context each, legacy lines fall back to keywords; `--help` prints usage)
- `wemind config show|home-mode|reload|agent|wechat|reply-style` (mode, real Agent config, WeChat-only overlay, WeChat reply style; `agent` writes the real config with a backup)
- `wemind mcp list|enable|disable|add|remove` (brain MCP activation set in `managed`; in `direct` the chat `加载/卸载` messages are passed through to the Agent)
- `wemind workspace show|set|reset [--role brain|worker]` (default workspace; changes apply to new sessions)
- `wemind env capture|show|clear [--dry-run]` (non-secret environment snapshot: PATH/proxy/locale)
- `node packages/wechat-daemon/dist/cli.js list` (same thing from source)
- `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/doctor.ps1`
- `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/check-docs.ps1`
- `node scripts/acp-probe.mjs` (env: `ACP_BIN`, `ACP_ARGS`, `ACP_SHELL`, `ACP_HOME_ENV`, `ACP_HOME`, `ACP_MODEL`)

## Hard facts (2026-11-14)

- Published: `@wemind/wechat-mcp` and `@wemind/cli`. Never publish `@wemind/wechat-ilink-core` (private, inlined).
- Package name ≠ command name: `@wemind/cli` installs the `wemind` binary. `npx` must use the package name.
- Two output channels (`core/logging.ts`): `createLogger(scope).info/warn/error/debug` writes `[wemind/<scope>][LEVEL] ...` to stderr (DEBUG reserved, enabled by `WEMIND_LOG_LEVEL=debug`); `print()` writes plain CLI user output to stdout with no prefix. Levels are embedded in the text, not split across stdout/stderr, because the watchdog merges both into one `daemon.log` and MCP stdout carries JSON-RPC. `wemind log --errors` matches `[ERROR]`/`[WARN]` markers (legacy lines fall back to keywords).
- Error stacks: `core/stack-map.ts` reads the colocated `.js.map` in `describeError()` and matches stack frames to the bundle by **full path**, so npm-global / `npx` installs under `node_modules` map too. Callback-based components (`SendPipeline`, task/control inbox runners, `AcpHost`) take the level as the first log argument. `scripts/run-daemon.ps1 -Mode shell` writes `[INFO]`/`[WARN]`/`[ERROR]` wrapper lines as well.
- Process identity uses three marker sets (`proc-identity.ts`): `wemind` + `cli.js` (npm install and absolute repo path), `wechat-daemon` + `dist` + `cli.js` (running from the repo root with a relative path), and `run-daemon.ps1` (source-checkout wrapper). `wechat-daemon` alone is never sufficient — the published package directory is `@wemind/cli`.

- Default brain selection is `auto`: `opencode → cline → qoder → gemini → deepseek → kiro`; persisted in `<data>/brain.json`. Adapter presets (`claude-code`, `codex`, `pi`) and native ACP `copilot` are never auto-probed — select them explicitly because installation does not guarantee authentication.
- `session/load` is not universal. DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 returns `-32601`; it has `session/resume` instead.
- Session maps are namespaced per brain: `brain-sessions.json` keyed `<agent>:<userId>`, `worker-sessions.json` keyed `<agent>:task-<编号>@<userId>` (one session per task, so a restarted task keeps its own context); legacy bare keys migrate to the current brain on first read (`session-map.ts`).
- DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 advertises `promptCapabilities.image:false`; image prompts fail with `-32602`.
- Qoder CLI 1.1.78 has load/resume/images/MCP and needs `.auth/user` + `.auth/machine_id` synced into the account copy; its MCP lives in `settings.json.mcpServers`.
- Cline CLI 3.0.74 has native ACP (`cline --acp`), `loadSession` (context survives a hard kill via `session/load`), but **no image input** (it advertises `image:true` yet ACP `prompt` keeps only text blocks, so the preset is `images:false`). Its ACP auth only restores `cline`/`cline-pass`/`openai-codex`; custom providers require `CLINE_PROVIDER`+`CLINE_API_KEY`. It ignores ACP `session/new.mcpServers` — MCP goes through `CLINE_MCP_SETTINGS_PATH` (`{mcpServers}`), and `session/close` is not implemented.
- Claude Code needs the official adapter `@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp` (global install, Node ≥22; Windows `claude-agent-acp.cmd`). The `managed` mode uses `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (which also isolates `~/.claude.json`), MCP goes via ACP `mcpServers`, and approvals are bypassed with `session/set_mode bypassPermissions`. Probe-verified plus a WeChat single-turn E2E; restart-continuity/MCP/task re-checks pending.
- Codex needs the official adapter `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` (global install; Windows `codex-acp.cmd`; current baseline 2.6.0). It has no config-dir redirection — config always lives in `~/.codex`, and cwd is the role workspace (`<account>/workspace/{brain,worker}` or task `--cwd`), not a config-copy root; `load`, images, `set_mode`, `set_config_option(model)` and client-provided stdio MCP all work (the latter verified on 2.5.0 and 2.6.0; `mcpCapabilities.acp=false` only means MCP-over-ACP), so the preset sets `acpMcpServers: true` and uses ACP delivery only when WeMind manages MCP. Native `~/.codex/config.toml` MCP entries are loaded by Codex itself and win on name conflicts; `direct` does not resend them. Probe-verified plus E2E on both worker and brain channels (2026-11-01); image / cold-restart re-checks pending.
- Gemini is a native ACP preset (`gemini --acp --approval-mode yolo --skip-trust`, 0.66.0). The `managed` mode uses `GEMINI_CLI_HOME` with config under `<root>/.gemini`; MCP lives in that `settings.json` (`settingsBase` strips only `mcpServers`), and credentials sync `.env` plus Google OAuth files. `session/set_config_option` is unsupported (`modelArg: "--model"`); `session/load` returns before it finishes replaying history, so `replayOnLoad` waits for frame quiet. Probe + E2E (single turn, restart `session/load` without history leak, hot switch, worker) passed 2026-11-01.
- GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.107 is a native ACP preset (`copilot --acp --no-auto-update --allow-all-tools`), probe-tested on Windows 2026-11-09; WeChat E2E is pending. `COPILOT_HOME` isolates config, syncing `config.json`, skills, and `copilot-instructions.md`; MCP is read from `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json` and sent through ACP stdio MCP. Strong-kill `session/load` recovery and stdio MCP invocation passed; image support is model-dependent and was not verified.
- pi needs both `npm i -g pi-acp` and `npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` (the preset's `requiresBins: ["pi"]` reports a missing runtime early). The `managed` mode uses `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`; MCP is pi's own `<root>/mcp.json` (kiro shape, `acpMcpServers: false`); no approval switch needed. Probe + E2E (brain single turn, hot switch both ways, WeChat `任务 pi：…`) passed 2026-11-01. `pi-acp` still reads `~/.pi/pi-acp/session-map.json`, `~/.pi/agent/prompts`, `~/.agents/skills` from the user's home.
- Qoder's user memory lives in `~/.qoder/memory/`; `direct` shares it directly, and `managed` junctions it in (brain writes land in the user's dir). `skills/agents/commands/AGENTS.md` do not exist in 1.1.78. Qoder Desktop may register MCPs in `~/.qoder/mcp-router.json` instead of `settings.json`, so those are intentionally invisible to `列出 MCP`.
- The repo has no `Brain` interface; `acp-brain.ts` exports `askBrain`/`newSession`/`restart`.
- iLink consecutive send limit is ~10; progress messages consume it.
- Windows `.cmd`/`.bat` agents must be launched through a shell; `binWin` must match the actual filename (e.g. `dsh.cmd`).
- kiro's ACP engine (v2/v3) is auto-detected: for v3 WeMind drops the v2-only `--trust-all-tools`/`-a`/`--trust-tools` flags, adds `--agent-engine v3`, and writes allow-all rules to the managed `settings/permissions.yaml`; `_meta.kiro.policyPreset` was probed and does not work.
- DSH `isolateSessions` (managed only) writes a `--patch` file pointing the session root to `agent-sessions/deepseek/<role>`, keeping its session store away from kiro/pi flat files (avoids `unsupported flat-file layout`).
- `wemind brain` uses `acpModelHint()` to warn when `- id: acp`'s model is no longer in the provider catalog (hint only; the user profile is never modified).
